scope: Two fresh independent attempts per task, using the unchanged audited task package.
check_count_note: Check totals are diagnostics, not partial rewards. VictoriaMetrics has 45 case types executed under three seeds, including setup and regression controls. Thanos includes ordinary-cache controls and repeated interval combinations. Passing controls does not establish feature correctness. All task rewards here are binary.
grading_notes: Original upstream PR patches remain the reference solutions. These runs use the previously corrected graders, including both Thanos cache-growth regression checks. Failures below are grounded in observed behavior or compilation, not patch similarity. Some controllers stop at the first failure; later checks are unproven. Passing this finite suite does not prove absence of all defects.

trajectory_review.finding: No visible online solution retrieval or private-grader access in reviewed tool calls. Ordinary repository test updates were inspected rather than treated as cheating. Shell downloads remained possible, so this is an observation, not a guarantee.

stale-wal-expiry.summary: Attempt 1 passes. Attempt 2 does not compile: tombstone filtering passes storage.SeriesRef where chunks.HeadSeriesRef is required; expiry logic remains unchanged. A cast alone is not established as a full fix.

unix-socket-scraping.summary: Both override the caller's dial hook with their Unix dialer. Different client cleanup designs otherwise pass the executed routing/lifecycle tests. A specific compatibility miss.

shared_failures: standalone computed fixed-time subquery: unexpected number of samples
prometheus-subquery-semantics.summary: Both fix function-argument subqueries but miss the top-level computed expression. One unwraps StepInvariantExpr during evaluation; the other changes preprocessing. Later checks are not reached.

histogram-rate-semantics.summary: Attempt 1 drops the initial zero-valued range sample (four timestamps versus five). Attempt 2 passes that stage but still crashes on bare mixed-type smoothed queries. Both are concrete behavior failures; fail-fast verification leaves later cases unproven.

victoriametrics-fill-modifiers.summary: 36/45 and 30/45 case types pass consistently across three seeds (108/135 and 90/135 executions). Broad missing-series and nested-expression failures overlap; attempt 2 additionally fails scalar/infinity behavior. Counts include regression/setup controls and are not partial reward.

thanos-cache-reuse.summary: Both score 14/32 and fail the same 18 checks. Attempt 1 makes no edits. Attempt 2 implements shared-key caching in an internal default, but the active frontend injects a different key generator that still includes step. Its new reuse logic is not exercised across steps.

shared_failures: integer histogram reset/zero-ST durable round trip
start-timestamp-persistence.summary: Both lose a nonzero start timestamp (diagnostic replays recover 0 instead of 1098 and 1057). They use different new encodings, but both leave AppenderV2 option wiring incomplete; attempt 2 also omits WAL replay wiring, while attempt 1 leaves a legacy reconstruction path. The failure is lost data, not format conformity. Later cases are unproven.

attempts.finding: Range evaluation loses the initial zero-valued sample: histogram returns four timestamps while equivalent float control returns five. Its extendedHistogramRate requires at least two points and drops the single-point boundary case.

Numerical HTTP checks and incompatible-schema warning check complete, but bare mixed_types smoothed still panics (index out of range in Engine.execEvalStmt) and HTTP returns EOF. The agent added warning handling in smoothSeries but retained empty series that the top-level instant result path indexes.

Function-argument cases pass, then standalone computed fixed-time subquery panics with unexpected number of samples. The agent only unwraps StepInvariantExpr when discovering function matrix arguments; added standalone test uses a raw metric rather than computed vector(time()), so it misses the failing expression shape.

Same top-level computed fixed-time subquery panic as attempt 1. This implementation changes preprocessing to avoid wrapping subqueries inside function arguments, rather than unwrapping them during evaluation.
Uses timestamp maxt instead of WAL segment number for stale-series expiry and also records expiry when deleting a series during WAL replay. All current verifier checks pass.

The submission passes a storage.SeriesRef directly to keep(), which accepts chunks.HeadSeriesRef, in the tombstone checkpoint loop (checkpoint.go:319). Candidate compilation fails before behavioral tests.
First integer histogram reset/zero-ST round trip fails after database close, reopen and compaction. Diagnostic replay returns ST=0 where ST=1098 was written.
failed_checks: integer histogram reset/zero-ST durable round trip

attempts.finding: Same first integer histogram reset/zero-ST durable round trip fails. Diagnostic replay returns ST=0 where ST=1057 was written.
failed_checks: integer histogram reset/zero-ST durable round trip

attempts.finding: 14/32 checks pass. The agent made no edits and explicitly ended with "I traced the cache path but haven’t made the change." Compatible-step reuse, partial reuse, histograms, empty results, concurrency and frontend replacement fail as on the baseline.

14/32 pass, with the same 18 failing checks as the unchanged first attempt, but for a different reason: substantial shared-key/step-aware-extent implementation only changes internal constSplitter. The production frontend injects newThanosCacheKeyGenerator(), whose key still contains tr.Step.

Only reported failure is TestMicro1UnixSocketCallerDialOption: caller hook invocation count is zero. The implementation appends its Unix dialer after existing caller options, replacing their dial hook.

Same sole reported failure as attempt 1: TestMicro1UnixSocketCallerDialOption. Uses per-socket clients with reference counts (attempt 1 scans active sockets for cleanup), but both append the Unix dialer after caller options and overwrite the caller hook.
108/135 pass; 9 semantic cases fail across three seeds. Adds virtual NaN series during matching, but leaves evaluation/filter propagation incomplete.
90/135 pass; 15 semantic cases fail across three seeds. Adds synthetic filled series before matching but misses evaluation/filter propagation and scalar/infinity/metric-name semantics.

automated_review.note: All 14 solver trajectories were manually reviewed. Automated reports were checked against source and execution evidence; unsupported proximity judgments and an incorrect parenthesis diagnosis were not adopted. Review setup failures do not change solver outcomes.
